name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Walking goes with Pierce or Gardening goes with Conservatory (but not both) if and only if Conservatory goes with Ashford.
Crane does not go with Sleeping if and only if either Veranda goes with Crane or Holloway goes with Lounge (but not both).
Crane, Holloway, and Cooking go with Kitchen, Lounge, and Veranda, in some order.
Between Kitchen and Veranda, one goes with Cooking and the other with Sleeping.
